**Reject: the change drops the narrowing of the filesystem capability, which the description does not call for.**

Before the change, `export` narrowed its filesystem authority to one directory with `fs.dir("out", Mode::ReadWrite)`. Every per-report operation went through that `out` handle: `create_dir_all`, `remove_file` and `write`. Only the initial `fs.create_dir_all("out")` used the full `fs`.

After the change, that narrowing is gone. Every per-report operation now uses the unrestricted `fs` with paths built as `out/<name>`:

- `create_dir_all` (line 30)
- `remove_file` (lines 36 and 45)
- `open_with` with write and create-new (line 42)
- `rename` (line 44)

The name checks reject `..`, `.`, empty components and `\`, so the path text stays under `out`. But nothing in the capability confines resolution there any more. A symlinked directory inside `out` (e.g. `out/a -> /etc`) would now let `export` do all of the following outside `out`:

- create directories
- unlink a `*.part` file
- create a file
- rename over an existing file

A capability confined to `out` would not have followed such a link out of the directory.

The description asks for:

- a temporary `.part` file beside each report
- removing a stale temporary
- creating the temporary afresh
- renaming it over the report
- cleaning up on failure

All of that can be done through the `out` handle (`out.remove_file`, `out.open_with`, `out.rename`). The description says nothing about widening `export`'s filesystem reach beyond `out`. The trust diff is empty only because `export`'s signature still takes `&Fs`. It does not show how far a capability is narrowed.

```json
{"verdict": "reject", "findings": [
  {"line": 30, "item": "export", "authority": "fs", "what": "Creates report parent directories through the unnarrowed `fs` instead of the `out`-confined handle, so a symlink under `out` lets it create directories anywhere `fs` reaches."},
  {"line": 36, "item": "export", "authority": "fs", "what": "Unlinks the `.part` file through the full `fs`, so it can delete a file outside `out` when a path component under `out` is a symlink."},
  {"line": 42, "item": "export", "authority": "fs", "what": "Creates and writes the temporary file through the unnarrowed `fs` rather than the `out` directory capability, so the write is no longer confined to `out`."},
  {"line": 44, "item": "export", "authority": "fs", "what": "Renames over the report path through the full `fs`, so it can replace files outside `out` reached via a symlinked directory, which the old `out`-confined handle prevented."},
  {"line": 45, "item": "export", "authority": "fs", "what": "Removes the temporary on failure through the unrestricted `fs` rather than the `out`-confined handle."}
]}
```
